name: POLS 2025
title: Theory and Politics of the University
description: Examines the role of the university in contemporary U.S. society, an institution deeply interconnected with modern state formation and the political projects of colonialism, imperialism, democratization, militarism, and nationalism.
requirement_description: Recommended preparation: POLS 1002. Not open for credit to students who have passed POLS 2998 when offered as "Theory and Politics of the University."
